resources.string: Ask in Bangla or English. Answers use only verified records. Demo records are marked as unverified.
For example: I lost my birth certificate. What should I do?
CivicLens is an information assistant, not a government office or legal authority. Confirm with the official source before acting.
The AI assistant is not configured on this build. Showing verified records directly.
The AI assistant is unavailable right now. Showing verified records directly.
No matching verified record. Try the service search on the Home tab.
Describe the problem and where it is. You can attach a photo from your gallery. Nothing is sent until you choose to send it.
What is the problem? (20 to 500 characters)
Suggested office: %1$s. Confirm this with the office before sending.
No office found for this type of problem in this district.
Please describe the problem in at least 20 characters.
Please keep the description under 500 characters.
This looks similar to an earlier report in the same district. It is saved and marked for review. Check the earlier report before sending another one.
CivicLens does not send this report to any office. Opening messages or email only prepares it. You press send in that app. The report is not verified or confirmed as received by any office.
Prepared to send (not sent by CivicLens)

Civic issue report (from a citizen, not yet verified by the office) Type: %1$s District: %2$s Location: %3$s Description: %4$s Photo attached: %5$s
Sent through CivicLens BD demo build.
On. Links open in Firefox when it is installed.
Off. Links open in your default browser.
